Name: Custom Museum Framework (CMF)
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
Custom Museum Framework (CMF) lets you create your own version of the vanilla museum run by Gunther. Unlike that museum, though, CMF provides you with [i]much[/i] more flexibility in basically all regards. You can customize just about any of the museum related features to curate your collection to your liking. There's no need to limit yourself to mimicking the vanilla museum one-to-one.

Oh, and custom lost books are there too, I guess. This is somewhat a Custom Library Framework too.

For a full explanation of what Custom Museum Framework can do and how to create your own museum, please see the documentation below or the example museum in the miscellaneous files.

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Usage For Players[/size][/b]
This mod does nothing on its own. There is no benefit to installing this as a user if another mod that you are using does not require it.

[b][size=5]Usage For Mod Authors[/size][/b]
[url=https://stardew.button.gay/docs/cmf]Click here for the documentation.[/url]﻿
